University College Cork publishes salaried research vacancies — PhD studentships and postdoctoral posts — through its HR portal, and this listing (1955779) is one of the current advertisements. Each posting carries its own closing date, project description, supervisor details and salary scale, so read the full advertisement before applying.

Programme Highlights

  • Salaried Irish research posts with public-sector pay scales
  • Posting-specific deadlines on the UCC HR portal
  • Direct employment route — no separate scholarship application
  • Cork's research ecosystem spans life sciences, engineering and food research

Who Should Apply

Candidates holding (or completing) the required degree for the specific post, with the research background described in the advertisement.

Funding and Costs

Salaried research position per the UCC pay scales stated in the advertisement.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the UCC vacancy page, confirm the closing date and required documents, and apply through the UCC recruitment system. Key deadline information: Closing date as stated in the UCC vacancy listing — check the posting before applying.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University College Cork (UCC)

University College Cork is a research-intensive Irish university whose HR portal advertises salaried PhD and postdoctoral positions across its colleges and research institutes.

Official website: https://www.ucc.ie

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Per vacancy advertisement - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
